mechanism: A short trailer can escalate genre without dialogue evidence by repeatedly returning to one protagonist while broadening the world in five causal registers: relationship, public activity, private vulnerability, physical danger and maximum spectacle. A separate final title card closes the promise; recurring faces and objects, not unverified speech meaning, carry continuity.

invariants.rule: Introduce one protagonist and one relationship anchor before the location count expands.
invariants.purpose: Gives montage a human identity spine.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated opening faces create a generic clip reel.

invariants.rule: Return to the protagonist while broadening public settings and group size.
invariants.purpose: Expands genre scope without losing identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Pure location montage loses narrative ownership.

invariants.rule: Insert a quieter private or clinical vulnerability phase before action escalation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Constant action leaves no emotional pressure change.

invariants.rule: Escalate from interpersonal pressure to visible public physical danger.
invariants.ablation_failure: An arbitrary explosion has no dramatic ladder.

invariants.rule: Separate the maximum spectacle from a held, original title lockup.
invariants.purpose: Closes the trailer as a promise rather than an unresolved scene.
invariants.ablation_failure: No title closure makes the montage feel like an excerpt.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source taxi nightlife hospital and boxing montage
